default/30404.htm.text: Newbie Helper: Welcome, young seeker. In this temple are all Dark Elves born, and here we worship the goddess of darkness, the first goddess of water, Shilen. I will be teaching you the basics of combat. Please click on Quest in your Chat window.

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).
